rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The report says the chair of the representative election administration committee reported that 神崎代表 was the only candidate, a selection without a ballot under rule 20(3) was put to the delegates, and the convention re-appointed 神崎武法代表 by the representative election ('代表選挙により神崎武法代表を再任').

rows.role_title: 代表 / 委員長 — representative of 公明党 and, until its December 1994 division, its chair (委員長)
rows.text: The report dated 3 November 2002 says the list of 35 new headquarters officers named by '新代表に再任された神崎代表' was announced and approved by the delegates.
